dreamteamer.title: Worktrees
dreamteamer.description: Parallel checkouts of a workspace. `dt worktree add|list|get|rm` cuts, lists, inspects and removes linked worktrees, each installed and compiled; `dt land` brings a worktree's committed records back onto the primary branch and stops on any conflict outside a generated block. Ships WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove hooks for a coding agent, and the `working-in-worktrees` skill.
